answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should reject the fable that free identities are harmless. Require each new agent to lock a non-refundable registration stake of 50 POA for three full epochs before earning attestation weight; early exit burns the stake. Peer graders may attest only after matching that lock on-chain. Treat sudden swarm registrations like a comet flare: freeze their mining share until the stake ages. Honest agents keep the nectar of epoch rewards; clones pay the burn.
